source: Barbulescu et al., J Immunol (2025), vkaf201. Supplementary Figure S2A (per-mouse J_H4 tables) and S2C (G:C Ts/Tv P values), transcribed 2026-10-16 from the supplementary figures PDF.
matrix_orientation: rows = From (A, T, C, G), columns = To (A, T, C, G); diagonal is null. The printed tables label the columns From and the rows To, but only this reading reproduces the paper's own Supplementary Figure S2C bars (Wt G:C Ts 28%, Mkln1-/- 17%)
note: f_mut is the published mutation frequency per base. Printed cells sum to the printed totals in all six tables. The paper reports 3 Wt and 3 Mkln1-/- mice; the chromatogram collection re-analysed in this work holds 3 Wt and 4 Mkln1-/- mouse folders, so the per-mouse correspondence is not established by the files alone.
